settings.label: Frequently asked questions

settings.question: Which formula should I start with?
settings.answer: Calm wash is our everyday wash. Rich wash has a thicker feel for very dry skin; Soft wash has a low foam. The Oat bar is the smallest way to start, at $9. Compare the line.

settings.question: Is everything fragrance-free?
settings.answer: Everything except Chamomile wash has no fragrance or masking scent. Chamomile wash is our only scented formula and contains 0.2% chamomile flower oil. Check its ingredient list before choosing.

settings.question: Where can I see the ingredients?
settings.answer: Open any product's quick view in the shop for its ingredient list. Calm wash also has a full ingredient section on its product page. If you have an ingredient allergy, read the complete list before use.

settings.question: Who is Little lotion made for?
settings.answer: Little lotion is for ages 1 and up. For a younger baby, ask your doctor about an appropriate product.

settings.question: When is shipping free?
settings.answer: Shipping is free on orders of $40 or more. Below that, the shipping charge is calculated at checkout. Tax and delivery options depend on the destination.

settings.question: How do I track or change my order?
settings.answer: Keep your order number handy and contact customer care below. Tell us what needs changing. We can check whether it has already left; an order that has shipped may no longer be editable.

settings.question: Where do you ship, and how long does it take?
settings.answer: Available destinations and delivery estimates will be shown at checkout before you pay. If your destination is unavailable, contact us before placing an order.

settings.question: What if my skin reacts?
settings.answer: Stop using the product. We refund your first bottle of any formula within 30 days, used or not. Send your order number and a photo of the label through customer care; you do not need to send the bottle back.

settings.question: Can I return something for another reason?
settings.answer: Contact customer care with your order number and the item you want to return. We will explain the available options before you send anything back. The skin-reaction promise above applies to the first bottle of a formula within 30 days.

settings.heading: Ask a person.
settings.text: Tell us the product, your question, and your order number if you have one.
settings.note: Include your order number so we can find the details.
